title: Steven Greer's benevolent-alien theory

tellings.quote: Show us Greer's theory is that they're all love and light and good.

plain: A UFO campaigner named Steven Greer holds that the beings visiting Earth are "all love and light and good," according to Michels. Michels sums up Greer's view this way himself, without quoting Greer, while debating a well-known skeptic on his show. He sets it up as one view among others on what the visitors want.
